wages.text: Garcia said he would advocate for higher workers’ wages and worker rights.
wages.quote: Garcia will advocate for raising workers’ wages, protecting worker rights, protecting retirement security

housing.text: Garcia said he supports rent-control legislation and relaxing rules that impede buyers and tenants from getting homes.
housing.quote: Garcia supports and will push for more rent control legislation. He also will support relaxing rules and regulations that make it difficult for buyers and tenants to get into homes.
